message.content:
This editorial illustration features two men standing on a sandy beach, holding long-handled wooden rakes. One man stands further back, wearing a white long-sleeved shirt and dark pants rolled to the calves. The second man, positioned in the foreground, wears a purple short-sleeved shirt and similar dark rolled-up pants. Both are barefoot. They use their rakes to scratch parallel lines into the sand, which take the literal form of a vertical barcode.

The background shows stylized waves meeting the shore under a grey and red header. Large white block letters spell "TEMPO" across the top. Below this, black text reads "KELAM KABUT PASIR LAUT." A paragraph of smaller Indonesian text is located on the left. Other headlines include "Koalisi Oleng Pengusung Anies H.24" and "Jejak Pegasus di Indonesia H.62." At the bottom, there is a smaller barcode, a QR code, the date "12-18 JUNI 2023," and "RP 50.000." The color palette is dominated by mustard yellow, grey, white, and shades of brown and purple.
